probeD.what: The fixer's OWN round-2 fix missed a mutation, and its own probe caught it.
probeD.detail: Collapsing the brand itself (ChangeInstanceId = string & {...} -> string) leaves src/ internally consistent: tsc exit 0, runtime 27 passed, and the new type assertions stayed GREEN. Cause: every bare-string assertion reached the brand through Parameters<typeof computeStorePlanningLayoutV2>[0]['changeInstanceId'], i.e. through VerifiedChangeInstanceId, which stays branded by its OWN symbol when the base collapses. So the parameter assertions held while the whole public vocabulary silently became string.
probeD.fix: An individual bare-string pin per branded name; re-ran the same mutation -> RED.
probeD.generalRule: A type assertion reached through a DERIVED type can be inert against the base type it depends on. Pinning Parameters<f>[0]['x'] against string looks like it pins the brand; it does not, because an intersection brand survives its base collapsing. Pin each name individually.
probeD.significance: FIFTH instance of the assertion-cannot-fail defect class, and the second one found inside work convened to close earlier instances. This is what moved the LEAD to fold a systematic discrimination sweep into round 3 rather than waiting for the round cap to force a strategy change.

leadError.what: The LEAD delivered the round-2 re-review instruction to the round-1 reviewer with SendMessage while that reviewer was PARKED in `rasen agent wait`.
leadError.why it failed: The signal file is the ONLY channel to a parked worker; SendMessage to a parked worker is explicitly forbidden. The instruction never reached it, it idled 12 beats, and the beat cap stood it down with the fix delta entirely unreviewed.
leadError.correctChannel: Write {"kind":"resume","instruction":"..."} atomically to <changeRoot>/signals/<role>.json - the same mechanism the LEAD used correctly to stand down the implementer.
leadError.note: The beat cap firing is by design and worked correctly; the defect was the LEAD's choice of channel, not the keepalive mechanism.
leadError.cost: One wasted park cycle (~54 min of reviewer wall-clock) and one retired worker. No work product lost - the reviewer's handoff carries a complete five-row re-verification recipe.
